title: Colossians Chapter 2 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Colossians chapter 2 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Colossians Chapter 2 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Colossians Chapter 2.

questions.question: In Colossians 2, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Great conflict for the Colossians and Laodiceans
Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy
Rooted and built up in Christ
As ye have received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him
questions.correctAnswer: Great conflict for the Colossians and Laodiceans
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:1 is the earliest verse mentioning the great conflict Paul has for the Colossians and Laodiceans.

questions.question: According to Colossians 2:2, what might their hearts be?
options: Comforted, being knit together in love
questions.correctAnswer: Comforted, being knit together in love
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:2 states that their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love.

questions.question: What are hid in Christ, according to Colossians 2:3?
options: All the treasures of wisdom and knowledge
questions.correctAnswer: All the treasures of wisdom and knowledge
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:3 says that in Christ are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

questions.question: Why does Paul speak in Colossians 2:4?
options: Lest any man should beguile you with enticing words
questions.correctAnswer: Lest any man should beguile you with enticing words
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:4 states Paul speaks to prevent anyone from beguiling them with enticing words.

questions.question: Though Paul is absent in the flesh, how does he say he is with them in Colossians 2:5?
options: In the spirit, joying and beholding their order and steadfastness
questions.correctAnswer: In the spirit, joying and beholding their order and steadfastness
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:5 explains Paul is with them in spirit, joying and beholding their order and steadfastness of faith.

questions.question: What instruction does Paul give in Colossians 2:6?
options: As ye have received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him
questions.correctAnswer: As ye have received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:6 instructs to walk in Christ as they have received Him.

questions.question: How are believers described in Colossians 2:7?
options: Rooted and built up in him, stablished in the faith, abounding with thanksgiving
questions.correctAnswer: Rooted and built up in him, stablished in the faith, abounding with thanksgiving
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:7 describes believers as rooted and built up in Christ, stablished in faith, abounding with thanksgiving.

questions.question: What does Paul warn believers to beware of in Colossians 2:8?
options: Philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men
questions.correctAnswer: Philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:8 warns to beware lest any spoil them through philosophy and vain deceit after human tradition.

questions.question: According to Colossians 2:1, for whom does Paul have a great conflict?
options: You, them at Laodicea, and as many as have not seen his face
questions.correctAnswer: You, them at Laodicea, and as many as have not seen his face
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:1 states Paul has great conflict for you, for them at Laodicea, and for those who have not seen his face.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the full assurance mentioned in Colossians 2:2?
options: Understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, the Father, and Christ
questions.correctAnswer: Understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, the Father, and Christ
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:2 states the full assurance is for understanding and acknowledging the mystery of God and Christ.

questions.question: What does Paul say about his physical presence in Colossians 2:5?
options: He is absent in the flesh but present in the spirit
questions.correctAnswer: He is absent in the flesh but present in the spirit
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:5 mentions Paul being absent physically but with them in spirit.

questions.question: True or False: According to Colossians 2:3, Christ contains all treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:3 clearly states in Christ are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

questions.question: True or False: Paul desires that their hearts be comforted and knit together in love according to Colossians 2:2.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:2 expresses Paul's desire for their hearts to be comforted and united in love.

questions.question: True or False: Colossians 2:8 warns believers to beware of physical hunger and thirst.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:8 warns against philosophy and vain deceit, not physical hunger and thirst.

questions.question: True or False: Colossians 2:6 instructs believers to avoid walking in Christ Jesus the Lord.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:6 instructs believers to walk in Christ Jesus the Lord, not to avoid it.

medium.title: Colossians Chapter 2 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Colossians Chapter 2 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What dwells in Christ according to Colossians 2:9?
options: All the fullness of the Godhead bodily
questions.correctAnswer: All the fullness of the Godhead bodily
questions.explanation: This answer is correct because Colossians 2:9 states, 'For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.'

questions.question: What does Colossians 2:10 promise will happen if someone is complete in Him?
options: They will have all principality and power
They will be judged by others
They will be filled with knowledge
questions.correctAnswer: They are complete in Him
questions.explanation: This is correct because Colossians 2:10 says, 'And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power.'

questions.question: According to Colossians 2:11, what is the circumcision made without hands?
options: The putting off the body of the sins of the flesh
questions.correctAnswer: The putting off the body of the sins of the flesh
questions.explanation: This is correct as Colossians 2:11 states, 'In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ.'

questions.question: What does Colossians 2:12 say about baptism?
options: It is a symbol of faith
It is a tradition of men
questions.correctAnswer: Buried with him in baptism
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:12 states, 'Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God...'

questions.question: What is the result of being quickened with Him according to Colossians 2:13?
questions.correctAnswer: Having forgiven you all trespasses
questions.explanation: This is correct as Colossians 2:13 states, '...hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses.'

questions.question: What does Colossians 2:14 indicate Christ did with the handwriting of ordinances?
questions.correctAnswer: Nailed it to his cross
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:14 states, '...and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross.' This indicates a removal of the ordinances that were against us.

questions.question: What is mentioned in Colossians 2:15 regarding principalities and powers?
options: He made a show of them openly
questions.correctAnswer: He made a show of them openly
questions.explanation: This is correct as Colossians 2:15 states, 'And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.'

questions.question: What warning is given in Colossians 2:16?
options: Let no man judge you in meat or drink
questions.correctAnswer: Let no man judge you in meat or drink
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:16 states, 'Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday...'

questions.question: What does Colossians 2:1 express about Paul's concern?
options: He wants them to know his conflict
He is upset with their behavior
He is indifferent to their situation
questions.correctAnswer: He wants them to know his conflict
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:1 states, 'For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you...'

questions.question: What is the purpose of being rooted and built up in Christ according to Colossians 2:7?
questions.correctAnswer: To be established in faith
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:7 states, 'Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith...'

questions.question: What does Colossians 2:8 warn against?
questions.correctAnswer: Philosophy and vain deceit
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:8 warns, 'Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit...'

questions.question: What is the relationship between being quickened with Him and forgiveness in Colossians 2:13?
options: Being dead in sins leads to quickening
Quickening is only for the righteous
questions.correctAnswer: Being dead in sins leads to quickening
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:13 shows that being dead in sins necessitates the quickening together with Him, indicating the connection.

questions.question: Is it true that the fullness of the Godhead dwells in Christ?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: This is true as stated in Colossians 2:9, 'For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.'

questions.question: Is it false that believers should be judged for their dietary choices according to Colossians 2:16?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: This is false because Colossians 2:16 clearly states, 'Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink...'.

questions.question: Is it false that Christ's circumcision is made without hands?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: This is false since Colossians 2:11 describes the circumcision made without hands, referring to the spiritual aspect of being circumcised in Christ.

hard.title: Colossians Chapter 2 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Colossians Chapter 2.

questions.question: According to Colossians 2:17, what are the 'shadow of things to come'?
questions.correctAnswer: The ordinances
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:17 states 'Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ,' referring to the ordinances as the shadow.

questions.question: In Colossians 2:18, what is Paul warning believers not to be beguiled by?
questions.correctAnswer: Worshipping of angels
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:18 warns 'Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels,' cautioning against angel worship.

questions.question: In Colossians 2:19, what is described as the 'Head' that holds the body together?
questions.correctAnswer: Christ
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:19 states 'And not holding the Head... from which all the body... increaseth with the increase of God,' referring to Christ as the Head.

questions.question: Colossians 2:20 questions why believers are subject to what, if they are dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world?
questions.correctAnswer: Ordinances
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:20 says '...why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,' questioning adherence to worldly rules.

questions.question: Which prohibitions are mentioned in Colossians 2:21 as examples of ordinances?
options: Touch not; taste not; handle not
Pray not; fast not; give not
Eat not; drink not; marry not
Speak not; see not; hear not
questions.correctAnswer: Touch not; taste not; handle not
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:21 explicitly lists 'Touch not; taste not; handle not' as examples of ordinances.

questions.question: What does Paul say about these commandments and doctrines of men in Colossians 2:22?
options: They all are to perish with the using
questions.correctAnswer: They all are to perish with the using
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:22 states 'Which all are to perish with the using,' indicating these human commandments are temporary.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'beguile' (παραπλανῶ) in Colossians 2:4 mean?
questions.correctAnswer: To deceive or mislead
questions.explanation: The Greek word 'παραπλανῶ' used in Colossians 2:4 means 'to deceive or mislead,' as Paul warns against being beguiled by enticing words.

questions.question: Which literary device is prominently used in Colossians 2:17 where the 'shadow' and 'body' are contrasted?
questions.correctAnswer: Typology
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:17 uses typology by contrasting the 'shadow' (old covenant ordinances) with the 'body' (Christ), foreshadowing fulfillment in Christ.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage best connects with Colossians 2:14's theme of 'blotting out the handwriting of ordinances'?
questions.correctAnswer: Jeremiah 31:31-34
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:31-34 prophesies a new covenant where God will forgive sins and 'remember them no more,' connecting with Colossians 2:14's theme of blotting out ordinances.

questions.question: Colossians 2:11 discusses circumcision 'made without hands.' Which New Testament passage echoes this spiritual circumcision?
questions.correctAnswer: Romans 2:29
questions.explanation: Romans 2:29 speaks of circumcision of the heart, not by the letter but by the Spirit, echoing Colossians 2:11's 'circumcision made without hands.'

questions.question: What verse directly precedes Colossians 2:17, explaining what men should not be judged about?
questions.correctAnswer: Colossians 2:16
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:16 precedes 2:17 and says 'Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday...,' setting context for the shadow mentioned in 2:17.

questions.question: In Colossians 2:23, Paul critiques certain practices as having the 'shew of wisdom.' What does he say about their effect on the flesh?
options: They have no honour in satisfying the flesh
questions.correctAnswer: They have no honour in satisfying the flesh
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:23 states these practices have 'not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh,' indicating they do not truly benefit the body.

questions.question: Which phrase in Colossians 2:19 symbolizes the unity and growth of the church body?
questions.correctAnswer: 'Joints and bands having nourishment ministered'
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:19 uses 'joints and bands having nourishment ministered' to symbolize how the church is united and grows through Christ, the Head.

questions.question: What is the underlying cultural concern addressed in Colossians 2:18 about 'worshipping of angels'?
questions.correctAnswer: Gnostic influences in the church
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:18 warns against 'worshipping of angels,' reflecting early Gnostic tendencies that emphasized angelic intermediaries, which Paul opposes.

questions.question: True or False: Colossians 2:23 teaches that strict bodily discipline is honored by God as a way to satisfy the flesh.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:23 explicitly says these practices are 'not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh,' so the statement is false.

theological.title: Colossians Chapter 2 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Colossians Chapter 2 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Colossians 2:3 teach about the nature of Christ in relation to divine wisdom and knowledge?
options: Christ contains all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge
Christ is a mere teacher of wisdom
Wisdom and knowledge are hidden from Christ
Christ is subordinate to human wisdom
questions.correctAnswer: Christ contains all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:3 states that "In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge," affirming the doctrine that Christ embodies all divine wisdom and knowledge.

questions.question: What doctrine does Colossians 2:11 teach regarding the believer's union with Christ and sanctification?
options: Believers are circumcised spiritually through Christ, putting off the body of sins
Physical circumcision is necessary for salvation
Sanctification is achieved by human effort alone
Christ's work is unrelated to sanctification
questions.correctAnswer: Believers are circumcised spiritually through Christ, putting off the body of sins
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:11 explains that believers undergo a spiritual circumcision "made without hands," symbolizing the putting off of the sinful body through Christ.

questions.question: What doctrine does Colossians 2:14 teach about the effect of Christ's atonement on the Mosaic Law?
options: Christ blotted out and removed the legal ordinances that were against us by nailing them to the cross
The Law remains fully binding on believers
Christ fulfilled the Law but did not abolish it
The Law was replaced with human traditions
questions.correctAnswer: Christ blotted out and removed the legal ordinances that were against us by nailing them to the cross
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:14 teaches that Christ "blotting out the handwriting of ordinances...nailing it to his cross" means the legal demands of the Law against us were removed through His atonement.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does verse Colossians 2:9 specifically demonstrate?
questions.correctAnswer: Immanence
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:9 states "For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily," highlighting the divine attribute of immanence—God's presence fully embodied in Christ.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Colossians 2:15 specifically demonstrate through Christ's triumph over principalities and powers?
questions.correctAnswer: Sovereignty
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:15 shows Christ "spoiling principalities and powers" and triumphing over them, demonstrating God's sovereignty over all spiritual authorities.

questions.question: How does Colossians 2:12 connect to the broader biblical theme of resurrection and new life in Christ?
options: It portrays baptism as a participation in Christ's death and resurrection
It emphasizes ritual purity as necessary for new life
It rejects resurrection and focuses on earthly life
It teaches that new life is earned by works
questions.correctAnswer: It portrays baptism as a participation in Christ's death and resurrection
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:12 describes being "buried with him in baptism" and "risen with him," linking baptism to the biblical theme of union with Christ's death and resurrection for new life.

questions.question: What redemptive-historical connection is highlighted by Colossians 2:17 in relation to Old Testament shadows and Christ?
options: The Old Testament rituals were shadows pointing to Christ as the true substance
The Old Testament laws remain the ultimate authority
Christ is subordinate to the Old Testament shadows
The Old Testament shadows have no relation to Christ
questions.correctAnswer: The Old Testament rituals were shadows pointing to Christ as the true substance
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:17 explains that the "holyday, new moon, or sabbath days" are shadows of things to come, but "the body is of Christ," affirming the typological fulfillment in Christ.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Colossians 2:13 and Colossians 2:14 teach about salvation?
options: God quickens believers from death and forgives all trespasses by removing the legal debt against us through Christ's cross
Salvation is earned by human effort and adherence to the law
Forgiveness depends on strict observance of ordinances
God forgives but does not remove legal accusations
questions.correctAnswer: God quickens believers from death and forgives all trespasses by removing the legal debt against us through Christ's cross
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:13 states believers are "quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses," and 2:14 shows God "blotting out the handwriting of ordinances," teaching salvation involves both new life and legal forgiveness through Christ.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Colossians 2:8 and Colossians 2:23 teach about false spirituality?
options: Human philosophy and legalistic traditions are vain deceit with a false appearance of wisdom
Legalistic practices are necessary for true wisdom
Philosophy is superior to the gospel
Spirituality is based solely on mystical experiences
questions.correctAnswer: Human philosophy and legalistic traditions are vain deceit with a false appearance of wisdom
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:8 warns against being spoiled by "philosophy and vain deceit," and 2:23 critiques will-worship and humility that have "a show of wisdom" but no true power, showing false spirituality's nature.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Colossians 2:6 and Colossians 2:7 teach about the believer's walk in Christ?
options: Believers must walk rooted, built up, and established in Christ, continuing in faith with thanksgiving
Faith alone is sufficient without growth
Believers should rely on legalistic observances for stability
Thanksgiving is unrelated to spiritual growth
questions.correctAnswer: Believers must walk rooted, built up, and established in Christ, continuing in faith with thanksgiving
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:6 commands walking in Christ as received, and 2:7 describes being "rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, abounding with thanksgiving," emphasizing ongoing growth and gratitude.

questions.question: Sceptics claim Colossians 2:16-17 teaches that Christian freedom allows disregard for all moral and ceremonial laws. What does Colossians 2:16-17 actually teach?
options: Believers should not be judged regarding food, drink, or festivals because these are shadows pointing to Christ
Believers are free to sin in all areas
The Law remains fully binding without exception
Christians must follow all Jewish ceremonial laws
questions.correctAnswer: Believers should not be judged regarding food, drink, or festivals because these are shadows pointing to Christ
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:16-17 states these observances are shadows of things to come, but the substance belongs to Christ, so believers are not to be judged on these matters, not that all laws can be ignored.

questions.question: What doctrine does Colossians 2:5 teach regarding apostolic presence and encouragement?
options: Although absent in the flesh, the apostle is present in spirit, rejoicing in the steadfast faith of believers
Physical presence is necessary for spiritual encouragement
Faith does not require apostolic witness
Encouragement depends on human wisdom alone
questions.correctAnswer: Although absent in the flesh, the apostle is present in spirit, rejoicing in the steadfast faith of believers
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:5 says Paul is "absent in the flesh, yet... with you in spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith," teaching spiritual presence transcends physical absence.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Colossians 2:13 demonstrate through God quickening believers from death despite their sins?
questions.correctAnswer: Mercy
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:13 reveals God "having forgiven you all trespasses" and quickening the dead in sins, showing His attribute of mercy toward sinners.

questions.question: What synthesis about spiritual nourishment and church unity does Colossians 2:2 and 2:19 teach?
options: Believers are knit together in love and nourished through Christ the Head, growing with the increase of God
Spiritual nourishment is individual and separate from the body of Christ
The church grows through human effort alone
Unity is unrelated to Christ’s headship
questions.correctAnswer: Believers are knit together in love and nourished through Christ the Head, growing with the increase of God
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:2 speaks of hearts knit in love, and 2:19 describes the body held together and nourished by the Head, Christ, teaching the unity and growth of the church through Him.

questions.question: What doctrinal warning does Colossians 2:18 provide regarding angel worship and spiritual pride?
options: Worshipping angels and intruding into unseen things leads to vain pride and is a deception
Spiritual pride is a sign of true humility
questions.correctAnswer: Worshipping angels and intruding into unseen things leads to vain pride and is a deception
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:18 warns against "worshipping of angels" and being "vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind," condemning such practices as deceptive and prideful.
